title: LeMay's unauthorized U-2 overflight of Russia

tellings.quote: It's crazy. He did uh and and launched the U2 ordered the U2 to fly over Russia to do the final retargeting

plain: In 1962, Curtis LeMay, the general in charge of the US Air Force, ordered a U-2, a high-flying American spy plane, to fly over Russia to do the final retargeting for a nuclear strike, without approval from above. The lawyer Dan Sheehan tells it without naming a source, as an example of military leaders acting behind the president's back.
